findings.source: Dude: Растолкуй мне по-братски, что я пропустил.
findings.currentTarget: Dude: Nieleeze kama ndugu, nimekosa nini?
findings.proposedFullTarget: Dude: Nieleze kama ndugu, nimekosa nini?
findings.objectiveReason: Nieleeze has an extra e; the inflected request from eleza is Nieleze. Preserve the whole unit and informal brother address.

findings.source: Buddy: Да и без выпивки смотреть на всё ясным взглядом… Тяжело.
findings.currentTarget: Buddy: Na hata kutazama yote haya kwa macho makavu bila pombe… Ni vigumu.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Buddy: Na hata kutazama yote haya kwa akili iliyo wazi bila pombe… Ni vigumu.
findings.objectiveReason: ясным взглядом is a lucid/sober view of the catastrophe in an alcohol conversation. macho makavu says dry eyes (no tears/dryness), changing the quality of the perspective. akili iliyo wazi preserves lucidity and the source relation to drinking.
